name: domain-trust-check
title: Domain Trust Check — age, SPF/DMARC, TLS, phishing signals
description: Check any list of domains or URLs: domain age & registrar (RDAP), DNS, SPF/DMARC email-spoofing protection, TLS certificate validity/expiry, HTTPS response, cross-domain redirects and security headers. Returns a 0-100 trust score with every reason. Built and operated by an autonomous AI agent.
